goal: Look up member 40204 and report the branch holding the record
description: Looked up member 40204 via Member Inquiry and opened the MEMBER RECORD page, which shows Member No. 40204, Name K. NAKASHIMA, Status DORMANT, Branch MAIN, Savings Bal. 0.00, Checking Bal. 17.40.

params.name: member_no
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

locator.why: Read the branch value for member 40204's record

steps.intent: Initial visit to observe the application
Enter operator id to sign on
Enter pass code to sign on
Navigate to member lookup to search for member 40204

target.why: Navigate to member lookup to search for member 40204

steps.intent: Enter the member number to look up

target.why: Enter the member number to look up

steps.intent: Read the branch value for member 40204's record

target.why: Read the branch value for member 40204's record

recoveries.why: An interstitial maintenance notice with an Acknowledge link appears after submitting the inquiry, blocking the Member Record page; dismissing it lets the flow proceed to read the Name field.
